race.description: Congratulations Gavin Bedggood Caulfield Cup Hcp (62)
race.comment: MIKE'S HOPE (4) gets the nod after two narrow placings, most recently third at Kyneton when beaten a neck after taking over before being claimed late. Back slightly to 1600m looks ideal, hard to run down. HE QUIET IMMORTAL (2) is the obvious danger, having run second at Geelong and Wangaratta in BM56 grade, and his 1600m record reads well with one win and five placings around the distance. Drawn to do no work, look for him slicing through late. ROUGH ENUFF (1) has won and placed at his past two, gets weight relief from Mornington and has Jamie Mott back aboard. He'll be swooping home. PLUCKY ENUFF (9) is the lightly raced improver, coming off a narrow maiden win at the Bool. Progressing nicely and can measure up again. CRIMSON MISS (8) is off a tough win in BM56 grade and can sneak into the minor money.
